name: GovNL Table of contents
description: Generates a hierarchical table of contents block from H2-H6 headings in a node, with configurable levels, threshold, and skip selectors.
project_description:
A Drupal module that automatically generates a table of contents based on the headings in your page content.

 Features 
 - Automatic detection : Automatically scans headings (H2-H6) in your content

- Hierarchical navigation : Displays nested lists based on heading structure

- Configurable : Choose which heading levels should be scanned

- Minimum threshold : Set how many headings are required to display the TOC

- Skip selectors : Exclude specific elements via CSS selectors

- Default skip selectors : Central configuration for selectors that should always be skipped

- Automatic IDs : Automatically generates URL-friendly IDs for each heading

- Special characters : Supports special special characters in headings

- Accessibility : ARIA labels for screen readers
